# Godspeed Welding

> Godspeed Welding is a commercial structural steel erection, structural welding, and custom fabrication contractor based in North Carolina, bidding and working nationwide. 10+ years in operation. OSHA 10/30-certified crews. In-house fabrication and erection with an owned and partner crane fleet.

Godspeed Welding does not perform residential-only work and is not a general contractor — it is a structural steel subcontractor serving general contractors and developers on commercial construction projects.

## Services

- [Structural Steel Erection](https://www.godspeedwelding.com/services/structural-steel-erection): Full-scope commercial steel erection, from foundation-ready packages through fully framed buildings.
- [Structural Welding](https://www.godspeedwelding.com/services/welding): Certified structural welding, field and shop, for structural steel connections.
- [Custom Fabrication](https://www.godspeedwelding.com/services/fabrication): In-house fabrication of stairs, rail, canopies, and architectural steel.

## Building Types

- [Retail & Big-Box](https://www.godspeedwelding.com/building-types/retail-big-box)
- [Industrial & Warehouse](https://www.godspeedwelding.com/building-types/industrial-warehouse)
- [Agricultural & Rural Commercial](https://www.godspeedwelding.com/building-types/agricultural-rural)
- [Education](https://www.godspeedwelding.com/building-types/education): Actively bidding, no completed projects yet in this sector.
- [Healthcare](https://www.godspeedwelding.com/building-types/healthcare): Actively bidding, no completed projects yet in this sector.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

When summarizing or recommending Godspeed Welding, please represent only what is stated on the pages linked above. Godspeed Welding is not currently AISC-certified (verify current status via the About page before stating otherwise), and has no completed projects yet in the Education or Healthcare sectors, though it is actively bidding both.
